target: Fix the ADHD Engine GET /api/v1/state key contract: it returns `energy` and `attention`, but the TUI (src/dopemux/ui/dashboard.py), .claude/hooks/check_energy.sh, services/adhd_engine/scripts/adhd-tmux-status.sh and the dope-memory recap read `energy_level` and `attention_state`, so those consumers silently show defaults. invariants: Edit services/adhd_engine/api/routes.py ONLY inside get_adhd_state (the `/state` handler, ~line 1555) and add the new test file. Do not touch any consumer; consumers are out of scope.

Add `energy_level` and `attention_state` to BOTH return paths (the normal return and the exception fallback), with values identical to `energy` and `attention`. Keep `energy`, `attention`, `session_minutes` and `user_id` exactly as they are (non-breaking).

Do NOT change `session_minutes` behaviour: it is always 0 today because `_session_start_times` is never set anywhere; fixing it needs core/engine.py changes and is a separate decision. State this limitation in the return.

Test (new file services/adhd_engine/tests/test_state_contract.py, follow the conventions in services/adhd_engine/tests/conftest.py and test_api.py): GET /api/v1/state returns all six keys; alias values equal their primary values; the exception fallback also returns all six keys; an unknown user_id works. Write the failing test first and show it fail before the fix.
The route is mounted at prefix /api/v1 (services/adhd_engine/main.py:531). Confirm by reading, do not assume.
No new dependencies, no config or compose changes, no API key requirement changes (the endpoint is deliberately keyless for local hooks).
